recognize_zh: 兩個嗜中性球的細胞質內可見粗大、深紫黑色的顆粒團，上方細胞同時有清楚的細胞質空泡（vacuolation），下方細胞為分葉核、黑色顆粒集中在細胞周邊；空泡加上異常黑色顆粒，對應敗血症毒性變化與造影劑相關色素。
features: Coarse dark purple-black granular clumps in the cytoplasm, peripheral in the lower cell and perinuclear in the upper cell
Distinct clear cytoplasmic vacuoles in the upper neutrophil
Background of normochromic red cells with several echinocytes
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two neutrophils with lobulated nuclei containing coarse, dark purple-black cytoplasmic granular aggregates; the upper cell additionally shows several clear cytoplasmic vacuoles. Red cells are normochromic with scattered echinocytes, and platelets are present. No intracellular microorganisms are identified. In a septic patient sampled after iodinated contrast, findings are consistent with pigment in neutrophils accompanied by toxic changes (vacuolation and toxic granulation).

ddx.vs: Toxic granules are finer and evenly distributed, without irregular black clumps.
Bacteria appear as discrete uniform cocci or rods, often within vacuoles, rather than amorphous black granules.
Shows lipid vacuoles in most neutrophils without dark granular pigment.
